name: Walpole
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Walpole, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Walpole, MA: the Santa Parade and tree lighting, Santa's house on the Common, a Nutcracker and A Christmas Carol on stage.
lede: Walpole kicks off Christmas with a Santa Parade to the town center and a tree lighting, then keeps the season going with Santa's house on the Common and holiday shows.
celebrates: Walpole's season starts with the Santa Parade, which rolls from Walpole High School down Common Street to the town center, led by police and fire vehicles. That evening the town tree is lit, with decorations from Walpole Lights, an all volunteer group. Santa's house opens on the Main Street Common, with caroling, hot chocolate and donuts on some nights. Walpole Children's Theatre stages holiday shows at Footlighters Playhouse in East Walpole, and local dance studios bring Nutcracker performances to Walpole Middle School.
lastyear: Hometown Weekly reported that Walpole's 2025 Santa Parade began at Walpole High School at 11 am, with police and fire vehicles leading the way down Common Street to the town center. The tree lighting that evening featured decorations by Walpole Lights, a newly coordinated group of volunteers. Walpole Downtown later invited families to Santa's house on the Main Street Common, with caroling led by Ed Jackowski.
facts: Walpole Children's Theatre was founded in 1969 and does not charge children to perform. Its shows take place at Footlighters Playhouse on Scout Road in East Walpole. The Walpole tree lighting got a new look in 2025, when the all volunteer Walpole Lights group took on the decorating. Santa's house sits on the Main Street Common in the town center, where the Santa Parade ends.
trains: Walpole station is on the MBTA Franklin/Foxboro Line, in the town center near the Common where Santa's house stands. Trains run north through Norwood and Dedham to South Station in Boston, so families can combine a Walpole evening with holiday sights in the city. Check the MBTA timetable for weekend service. For a Christmas train ride, Edaville in Carver runs holiday trains through a park full of lights.

faq: When is the Walpole Santa Parade?

The Walpole Santa Parade takes place in late November. In 2025, on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, it left Walpole High School at 11 am and traveled down Common Street to the town center, led by police and fire vehicles, Hometown Weekly reported. The town tree lighting followed that evening in the town center.
Where is Santa's house in Walpole?

Santa's house stands on the Main Street Common in the town center. Walpole Downtown posts the nights Santa is in, and some evenings include caroling led by Ed Jackowski with hot chocolate and donuts. Walpole station on the commuter rail is close by, so families can arrive by train.
Who decorates the Walpole Christmas tree?

Since 2025 the decorations have come from Walpole Lights, an all volunteer group that came together to brighten the town center for the holidays. Hometown Weekly reported that the newly coordinated group's work was on show at the tree lighting after the 2025 Santa Parade.
Are there holiday shows for kids in Walpole?

Yes. Walpole Children's Theatre, founded in 1969, puts on shows at Footlighters Playhouse, 2 Scout Road in East Walpole, and local dance studios such as Exhale Dance perform Nutcracker shows at Walpole Middle School. Check each group's ticket page for prices and age guidance.
